text.brief: A colonel signs an order in 2049 that machines drafted, checked and war-gamed. She realizes that no one left on her staff could have written it.
text.record: A presidential memorandum of June 5, 2026 ordered the Pentagon to revise its directive on autonomy in weapon systems within 90 days ([NSPM-11 (White House, June 5, 2026)](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2026/06/national-security-presidential-memorandum-nspm-11/)). The directive, last updated in January 2023, requires appropriate human judgment over the use of force. The Pentagon awarded contracts worth up to $200 million each to four AI companies in July 2025.
text.reading: The Party waits while American staffs hand their judgment to machines. When the machines err, no one can tell. The Party's patience then meets a rival that can no longer think without help. This is Stratagem 4, wait at ease for the weary enemy.
text.coreEvent: Before 2050 an American command acts on a wrong AI recommendation that no one on its staff could have checked.
text.gapText: Application Architecture. Staff workflows hand judgment to machines without keeping the skill to check them.
text.fix: Keep the human skill alive on purpose, with drills that run without the machine.
